parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The current operational state of the tunnel.

parameters.name: RemoteEndpoints
parameters.description: The Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) or IP address of the remote L2TPv3 tunnel endpoint. If more than one name/address is supplied, they will be tried in turn, i.e. they are in decreasing order of precedence.

parameters.name: KeepAlivePolicy
parameters.description: The mechanism used to keep the tunnel from timing out at the {{param|ConnectedRemoteEndpoint}}.

parameters.name: KeepAliveThreshold
parameters.description: Number of KeepAlive messages unacknowledged by the {{param|ConnectedRemoteEndpoint}} before the {{object}} is perceived failed.

parameters.name: DeliveryHeaderProtocol
parameters.description: The protocol used for the delivery header.

parameters.name: DefaultDSCPMark
parameters.description: If the specified entries in the {{object|#.Filter}} table do not match this {{object}} object or an instance of the {{object|Interface}} object for this {{object}} object, then the value of this parameter is applied to the delivery header of the packets in this {{object}}.

parameters.name: TunnelEncapsulation
parameters.description: The protocol that this {{object}} will be encapsulated

parameters.name: ConnectedRemoteEndpoint
parameters.description: The Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) name or IP address of the connected remote L2TPv3 tunnel endpoint.

object.description: L2TPv3 Tunnel table, models the L2TPv3 Tunnel instance and represents the entry point and exit point of the tunnel in relation to the WAN interface. A {{object}} object has one or more {{object|Interface}} objects that further define the sessions or flows within the tunnel.
